feeds.title: Economic Sociology and Political Economy
feeds.description: The Economic Sociology and Political Economy community (ES/PE), founded and led by Dr. Oleg Komlik, is the largest global online scholarly society that brings together academics, students, practitioners, and activists interested in these fields of study and life. Our primary purpose is to disseminate the insights of socio-political research on economies and economics to the public and academics.

feeds.title: ROAPE Blog
feeds.description: ROAPE's blog hosts short articles to highlight developments on the continent and comment on the dynamics of protest, shifting patterns of political economy, and issues of historical concern for the journal. The Review of African Political Economy (ROAPE) is a quarterly journal and website providing radical analysis of trends, issues and social processes in Africa.

feeds.title: European Centre for International Political Economy (ECIPE) Blog
feeds.description: The European Centre for International Political Economy (ECIPE) is an independent and non-profit policy research think tank. We are a research-based think tank with the ambition of providing decision-makers and observers with sound economic and political analysis.

feeds.title: Progress in Political Economy
feeds.description: This blog is a venue for thought about political economy in and beyond the academy. It is linked to faculty members, students, alumni, journalists, and others associated with the Department of Political Economy at the University of Sydney.

feeds.title: Scott Gehlbach Blog
feeds.description: Political economy, variously defined. A political economist and comparativist, Gehlbach's work is motivated by the contemporary and historical experiences of Russia, Ukraine, and other post-communist states.

feeds.title: Foreign Affairs » Political Economy
feeds.description: Stay up to date on the latest news, analysis, and commentary on Political Economy. Foreign Affairs is a magazine of U.S. foreign policy and international affairs, founded in 1922.

feeds.title: The Lowe Down
feeds.description: The Lowe Down is the Lowe Institute of Political Economy's official blog. We provide analysis on salient economic and political issues with a focus on Southern California.

feeds.title: Policy Analysis and Political Economy Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the blog of the professorship for Policy Analysis & Political Economy of the University of Kaiserslautern! In this blog, we want to inform you about our daily work. Here we post updates and information on our research projects, new publications, conferences visits, and much more.

feeds.title: The Political Economy Review
feeds.description: The Political Economy Review is a King's College London student-led publication focused on providing unbiased political and socio-economic analyses of relevant societal phenomena and current affairs.

feeds.title: Arctic Centre Blog
feeds.description: Researchers from the Northern Political Economy Research Group (NPE) share their thoughts and insights related to the Arctic from everyday to social, political and economic perspectives. Arctic Centre is a hub of information conducting multidisciplinary research on changes in the Arctic.

feeds.title: GY's political economy Blog
feeds.description: Thoughts on economic policymaking by George Yarrow. He is a lifetime student of political economy, retired academic and regulator.
